newsitem.title: UK: Thistle Hotels sets slim premium on debut.
newsitem.headline: Thistle Hotels sets slim premium on debut.

text.p: Shares in Thistle Hotels Plc set a slim premium on their issue price in active trading on Wednesday as the stock made its debut on the London exchange.

Shares in Thistle -- the second largest British hotels group -- were quoted around 172-1/2 pence compared with the offer price of 170 pence set overnight and announced in a statement by the company's major shareholder, New Zealand's Brierley Investments, which now has 46.0 percent.
Volume in Thistle reached 20.4 million shares in morning trade, making it the most actively traded stock in London.
The company raised some 237.6 million pounds through the offering, which gave it a market value of some 1.05 million pounds ($1.64 million), at the bottom of the indicated range for the float.

A spokesman for the company said it was "gratified" to be trading at a premium to the issue price but that the company's true value was expected to emerge over coming weeks and months rather than in the first few hours of dealing.
"What we wanted to do in the offering was ensure we got the right shareholder base and that we have succeeded in doing," the spokesman said.

The setting of the price at the low end of the range of 170 to 210 pence initially set by Brierley comes after a spate of initial public offerings by British hotel companies that some analysts feared would create a glut in the market.

Hotel operators have benefitted from the recent recovery in British business and consumer activity after a lengthy downturn, and interest in the sector was given a further boost by Granada Group's bid for Forte -- the country's biggest hotel group.
Analysts said Thistle had looked expensive at the upper end of the suggested price range.

"The general perception was that it was quite an expensive offering on measures such as cash flow, historic return on capital and normalised earnings before depreciation and tax," said Fraser Ramzan, analyst at Lehman Brothers.
Thistle has 100 hotels with over 13,500 rooms, including 24 hotels in London and 25 in Scotland. ($1=.6387 Pound)
